tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Action Blue, the only interactive colour. Fill of primary pill CTAs, text links on canvas, canvas-parchment and surface-pearl (5.6:1 on canvas), and the border of the secondary pill. Never decorative.

tokens.name: primary-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (2px solid outline, 2px offset) and the 2px border of a selected option chip. 4.7:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: primary-on-dark
tokens.usage: Text links on dark tiles (surface-tile-1/2/3, 5:1 on tile-1). Never on light surfaces; buttons on dark tiles stay primary.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on canvas, canvas-parchment and surface-pearl (16:1+). Also the fill of the dark utility button.

tokens.name: body
tokens.usage: Paragraph text on light surfaces; same tone as ink — one near-black for all copy.

tokens.name: body-on-dark
tokens.usage: All text on dark tiles and on the global nav (surface-black).

tokens.name: body-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy on dark tiles (10:1 on surface-tile-1) where white is too loud.

tokens.name: ink-muted-80
tokens.usage: Text on surface-pearl buttons and footer body copy on canvas-parchment (11:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted-48
tokens.usage: Disabled button text, legal fine print, timestamps. Source value: 4.3:1 on canvas and 3.9:1 on canvas-parchment — below 4.5:1 for small text; use only for non-essential text.

tokens.name: divider-soft
tokens.usage: The 3px soft ring on pearl capsule buttons; reads as a ring, not a line. Decorative, not a boundary.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px border on utility cards and option chips. Decorative (1.3:1); never the only cue for state.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Dominant page and card background.

tokens.name: canvas-parchment
tokens.usage: Alternating light tiles, footer, frosted sub-nav and sticky bar (at 80% with backdrop blur), page canvas behind utility cards.

tokens.name: surface-pearl
tokens.usage: Fill of the pearl capsule (secondary) button, so it still reads as a button on canvas-parchment.

tokens.name: surface-tile-1
tokens.usage: Primary dark tile. Text: body-on-dark, body-muted, links primary-on-dark.

tokens.name: surface-tile-2
tokens.usage: A micro-step lighter dark tile, for a dark tile directly above or below surface-tile-1.

tokens.name: surface-tile-3
tokens.usage: A micro-step darker dark tile, for the bottom of a stack and player/media frames.

tokens.name: surface-black
tokens.usage: True void only: the global nav bar, full-bleed media backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-chip-translucent
tokens.usage: Base of the circular icon button over imagery; apply at 64% alpha (rgba(210, 210, 215, 0.64)). Icon in ink.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (5.6:1).

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink or surface-black fills (dark utility button, global nav).

families.display: "SF Pro Display", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, sans-serif
families.text: "SF Pro Text", system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, sans-serif

styles.name: hero-display
styles.usage: One hero headline per page. Steps down to 40px at 1068px, 34px at 640px, 28px at 419px.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section heads; set in the text family at display proportions.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Tile subcopy under a display-lg headline.

styles.name: lead-airy
styles.sample: Обрабатывается, обычно это занимает несколько минут.
styles.usage: Rare airy lead paragraphs; one of two places weight 300 is allowed.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: Sub-tile tagline and the category name in the sub-nav.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Давайте начнём с интеграции. Мы в прошлый раз остановились на том, что Jira синкается раз в час.
styles.usage: Default paragraph and long-read transcript text. 17px, never 16px; never tighter than 1.47.

styles.name: dense-link
styles.usage: Stacked link lists (footer columns, folder lists); the relaxed leading is intentional.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary captions, metadata, pearl button and chip labels.

styles.name: button-large
styles.usage: Large hero CTA label (the other place weight 300 is allowed).

styles.name: button-utility
styles.usage: Dark utility buttons and sub-nav links.

spacing.note: 8px base; sub-base steps for type adjustments. Source names are spacing.<step>; here space-<step>.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight type nudges.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between paired CTAs; utility button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Chip and search-input vertical padding; sticky bar vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Paragraph gap; matches the 17px body size.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Utility card padding; gutter between grid cards.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Sticky bar horizontal padding; block gaps.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Air below a tile headline; tile padding on small phones.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical padding inside a full-bleed tile. Tiles stack with 0 gap.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed tiles — never rounded.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline links styled as subtle chips (rare).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Dark utility buttons, inline card imagery.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Pearl capsule buttons only.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Utility cards, square media crops in a grid.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Everything that reads as an action: primary and secondary CTAs, option chips, search input.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circular icon buttons (44 × 44).

shadow.note: Exactly one shadow exists. UI elevation comes from surface change and backdrop blur, never from shadows on cards, buttons or text.

tokens.name: shadow-product
tokens.usage: Only under a product image resting on a surface. Never on cards, buttons, sheets or text.

backdrop.note: Backdrop filter for frosted bars; the source gives it as a typical baseline, not a formal token.

tokens.name: backdrop-frosted
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of the sub-nav and sticky bar, over canvas-parchment at 80% alpha.

tokens.name: bp-content-lock
tokens.usage: Content max width; margins absorb extra width. Utility grids 5 → 4 columns.

tokens.name: bp-small-desktop
tokens.usage: Hero drops to 40px; grids to 3 columns.

tokens.name: bp-tablet-landscape
tokens.usage: Global nav collapses to a menu button; tiles and grids to 2 columns.

tokens.name: bp-tablet-portrait
tokens.usage: Sub-nav keeps only the title and the primary action.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Single column; hero 34px.

tokens.name: bp-small-phone
tokens.usage: Tile padding 80px → 48px; hero 28px at 419px and below.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target; icon button, search input and global nav height.

tokens.name: size-subnav
tokens.usage: Height of the frosted sub-nav.

tokens.name: size-sticky-bar
tokens.usage: Height of the floating sticky bar.

tokens.name: measure-text
tokens.usage: Max width of text-heavy sections.
